quicktest.title: Quick Test
quicktest.idleHint: Type your app's URL in the browser on the left (e.g. http://localhost:3000), then start Quick Test. Omni records every click, network call, and error — so the agent knows exactly what broke.
quicktest.step1: Enter your app's URL in the address bar on the left and load it.
quicktest.step2: Click Start, then interact with your app as a user would.
quicktest.step3: When you see a bug, click Stop. Omni maps the trace to your code.
quicktest.androidStep1: Boot your Android emulator/device and open your app.
quicktest.androidStep2: Click Start (set the device serial if you have more than one), then use your app.
quicktest.androidStep3: When you see a bug, click Stop. Omni reads logcat and maps it to your code.
quicktest.windowsStep1: Set the path to your app's .exe in the field above.
quicktest.windowsStep2: Click Start — Omni launches the app and watches its output. Use the app.
quicktest.windowsStep3: When you see a bug, click Stop. Omni maps the crash/log to your code.
quicktest.liveHint: Recording — interact with your app in the browser on the left.
quicktest.restartHint: Discard this trace and start a new recording.
quicktest.startFailed: Could not start Quick Test. Load your app in the browser first.
quicktest.noBrowser: The embedded browser is not ready yet. Load your app's URL, then try again.
quicktest.noDevice: No Android device found. Boot an emulator/device (adb) and try again.
quicktest.noApp: Could not launch the app. Check the .exe path and try again.
quicktest.errorHint: Something went wrong. Try loading your app's URL in the browser first.
quicktest.expectedTextPlaceholder: Text that must appear after your actions
quicktest.expectedTextHint: Quick Test checks the rendered page when you stop. Leave blank to record diagnostics only.
quicktest.observationOnly: Observation complete - no pass condition was set
quicktest.inspectHint: Click an element in the app to capture its component, file:line, box and styles.

help.learnMore: Open the page where this value lives
help.pasteUrl: Paste the full connection string from your provider's dashboard to autofill every field below.
help.provider: Pick your managed host to auto-set engine, port and SSL. Choose Custom for a self-hosted server.
help.file: The absolute path to your local .sqlite / .db file on this machine.
help.host: The server address from your database provider's connection settings.
help.port: The port from your provider's connection settings (Postgres 5432, MySQL 3306 by default).
help.database: The database name shown in your provider's connection settings.
help.user: The database username from your provider's connection settings.
help.password: The database password set when you created the database. Providers don't show it again — reset it if lost.
help.accountId: Find this in the Cloudflare dashboard sidebar (Workers & Pages → Overview).
help.databaseId: Open your D1 database in the Cloudflare dashboard; the ID is on its settings page.
help.apiToken: Create an API token with D1 read access under Cloudflare → My Profile → API Tokens.
help.projectId: Find this in Firebase console → Project settings → General.
help.accessToken: A short-lived Google OAuth access token with Firestore access.
